brief.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing
Asset type: one Japanese basketball editorial thumbnail, landscape 16:9, target 1600×900 pixels, PNG.
Primary request: Create ONE finished thumbnail for バスケまとめ, for the fixed article about October 30, 2026 pre-game registered-player best-five selections based on current-season average EFF, separately in three leagues.
Style reference already inspected in this conversation: B-culver-black-lime-v3.png. Use ONLY its graphic vocabulary: near-black #151A18 background, acid-lime #CCF43B bold dry-brush strokes, warm off-white heavy Japanese typography, orange basketball, energetic hand-ink sports illustration and sparse ink splatter. Do not reuse its player, date, names, scores, text, or numerical statistics.
Scene: a clean, powerful editorial poster. Left 65% holds strongly hierarchical type. Right 35% holds one large orange basketball with expressive black ink hatching and minimal off-white basketball-court line art, set against a lime diagonal brush stroke. No people, faces, hands, jerseys, team marks, sponsor names, trophy, scoreboards or depicted actual game events. The illustration is conceptual.
Composition: large calm text-safe zone on left, high contrast, ample margins at least 4% on every side, footer at least 3% above bottom edge. Main headline is dominant and easily legible on a phone. Keep layout uncluttered. Typography must be accurate Japanese; medium and small text clean sans-serif, headline very heavy Japanese sans-serif with a little rough brush texture in the giant numeral 5.
Exact visible text, all required and no additional wording:
Top small brand: 「バスケまとめ」
Date and phase below brand: 「2026.10.30 ｜ 試合前」
Main headline first line, large off-white: 「登録選手の」
Main headline second line, biggest type in lime: 「ベスト5」
Subheadline in off-white: 「今季平均EFFで選出」
League scope line: 「B.PREMIER / B.ONE / B.NEXT」
Visible qualifier line, readable and separate from the footer: 「リーグ別選出・出場は未確定」
Footer disclosure left: 「イラスト（AI生成）」
Footer disclosure beside it: 「成績をもとにしたイメージ」
Accuracy constraints: This is a PRE-GAME selection using season averages for registered players. Do not imply confirmed appearances, starting lineups, completed-game results, cross-league comparison, award winners or an official all-league best five. Do not include player names or any EFF figures. Date and the number 5 are the only numerical content. Keep every Japanese character and Latin abbreviation exactly as specified, including EFF. Do not add external-source claims.
Deliver exactly one complete opaque PNG image, approximately 16:9, width at least 1000px.
